ns2:course.label: Theory & Design Steel & Timber
ns2:course.description: Analysis and design of steel and timber structures for buildings. Steel columns, beams, trusses, connections, roof and floor framing systems; timber beams, columns, roof and floor framing systems. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ARCH 352.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ARCH 352.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one lab and one lecture section.
